notes: John O'Reilly's Confetti conference app — the Wear OS catalog, the sibling of joreilly-confetti-mobile. Same reasoning as that import: Confetti already applies ee.schimke.composeai.preview and publishes design-artifacts/confetti-wear from its own workflow, so this is an independent second path rather than the only one. The spec is the upstream catalog.spec.json (Confetti's root spec is the WEAR one; the phone sheet is catalog.mobile.spec.json) with `system` repointed at this slug. Wear is dark-first and round, so the spec carries smallRound/largeRound breakpoints and modes: [dark]. Android/Robolectric lane: these are AndroidX @Preview functions in wearApp/src/main. Confetti applies the plugin itself and pins composeai-preview to 1.14.1; the CLI skips injection for a module that already has it, so that version wins. cliVersion "catalog" pins the CLI to the same one rather than pairing a current CLI with a 1.14.1 plugin — what Confetti's own workflow does, and what /status.json shows built the confetti-* catalogs being served today. Split from the mobile catalog because the pipeline renders one module per import.
